thread:
maria: Heads-up — planning a subscriber "warmth" sequence to prime people for the product benchmark webinar (2 weeks out). Need three lanes (high/med/low engagement), subject lines, preview text, CTA routing, and who owns copy + scheduling. Prefer short sends, 1–3 messages per lane. Thoughts? :wave:

jon: I like 3 lanes. Proposal:
- High: immediate invite + social proof + register CTA
- Medium: rewarm + teaser + register CTA (1–2 sends)
- Low: education/nudge -> enter baseline nurture (no hard register ask)

sam: Agree. Quick ops notes: we should A/B subject lines, stagger sends by local time, and set a suppression for anyone already registered. Also suggest 2 triggers: opened last 30 days vs 31–90 vs >90.

lee: Segmentation question — what exact criteria for each lane? here's a quick draft:
- High: opened or clicked in last 14 days OR visited /docs/benchmarks
- Medium: opened in 15–60 days OR engaged with onboarding content
- Low: no opens in 61–365 days
Can tweak thresholds.

olivia: I'll take copy for all three lanes. Drafting voice: crisp, product-first, one CTA per email. Planning to write 3 subject variants per lane.

sam: Ops: sample SQL for high-engagement segment so eng/ops can mirror in Customer.io: 
```sql
SELECT id FROM subscribers
WHERE (last_opened >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 14 DAY) OR last_clicked >= DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL 30 DAY))
AND unsubscribed = false
AND registered_for_webinar = false;
```

jon: Routing rules: register -> convert to sales lead with tag `bench-webinar-2025`; if they don't register after 2 sends, drop to an evergreen benchmark nurture flow. Also add UTM params: utm_campaign=bench-webinar&utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email.

maria: Send windows — prefer Tue/Thu 10am local for High/Medium. Low = Fri 11am local as a softer touch. Keep cadence: High = send + reminder (48h) ; Medium = send + follow (5 days) ; Low = single nudge then monthly newsletter.

olivia: Draft subject lines (first pass):
High A: "See how X cut gen-time by 6x — join our benchmark webinar"
High B: "Benchmark results: the stack that cut inference cost"
High C: "Live: inference benchmark + Q&A — save your seat"
Preview (high): "Short demo + real numbers from teams like yours."

Medium A: "Benchmark highlights: what we learned"
Medium B: "Worth 20 minutes: inference cost & latency tradeoffs"
Medium C: "Sneak peek: benchmark takeaways"
Preview (medium): "Quick read + webinar invite."

Low A: "Quick guide to inference cost savings"
Low B: "How teams get predictable latency on budgets"
Low C: "Benchmarks, but start small: a primer"
Preview (low): "No fluff, just practical steps."

lee: Those sound good. For A/B, let's test subject line + preview combos on a 10% holdout for 48h then send winner.

sam: Automation checklist for rollout:
- Build segments in Customer.io
- Create templates (HTML + plain) and test in Litmus
- Set suppression list (already registered, unsubscribed, bounced)
- Add tracking & conversion events to the register CTA
- QA send to internal list + seed domains

maria: Ownership: Olivia = copy + 1st drafts by Mon EOD, Sam = build + schedule, Jon = routing & UTMs, Lee = segment SQL review. I'll own the final QA and send sign-off.

olivia: Will deliver drafts by Mon 9am PT. Will include 3 alt subject lines and 2 preview texts each.

jon: I'll prepare the lead routing spreadsheet and tag mapping, share by Tue noon.

sam: I'll start segment builds today and aim to have templates ready for QA by Wed.

maria: Perfect. One more ask: can we include a short 3–bullet set of benchmark highlights in the High lane email — measurable metrics only. Sam/lee, can you both confirm the top 3 metrics we should surface?

lee: Tentative top 3: median P95 latency reduction, tokens/sec improvements, per-token cost delta vs baseline quantization. Will confirm with infra by EOD.

sam: Confirmed we can pull those numbers from the benchmark dashboard — I'll export visuals for the landing page.

maria: Thanks all — keep updates in this thread. I'll create a checklist card in Asana and tag you. :white_check_mark:
